opennyai_summary.decision:
2. By this Application, the Applicant seeks pre-arrest bail in  connection with C. R. No. 86 of 2019 registered with the Kasa Police  Station, Palghar, for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 328,
 272, 273, 188 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 59 of  the Food Safety And Standards Act.
 3. Learned counsel for the Applicant submits that although the  vehicle from which prohibited food articles i.e. pan masala, gutkha etc.
 were seized, he was not present on the vehicle on the day when the Ranjeetkumar Hardev Shah vs The State Of Maharashtra on 27 June, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47875218/
1  vehicle was intercepted.
He further  submitted that taking the prosecution case as it stands, no offence  punishable under Section 328 is disclosed qua the Applicant.
In the meantime, till the next date, the Applicant is granted  interim protection on the following terms & conditions :-
 ORDER (i) In the event of arrest, the Applicant be enlarged on bail, on executing P. R. Bond in the sum of Rs.
50,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount;
(ii) The Applicant shall report to the investigating officer of the concerned police station on 3rd, 4th & 5th July, 2019 between 10.00 a. m. and 1.00 p. m. and thereafter, as & when called for by the investigating officer;
(iii) The Applicant to cooperate with the investigation.
6. Stand over to 16.07.2019.
To be listed on the Supplementary Board.
